notes.title: The Interface Doctrine
notes.notes: [p][i]“A doctrine is not mere instruction. It is an agreement between user and system, it is an architecture of trust.”[/i][/p][p]This major quality-of-life patch refines the interface between you and the world of [i]MORTAL ADVOCATE[/i]. From interaction to navigation, from control to clarity, these changes will make your experience smoother, faster, and more readable without changing the story’s pacing or emotional weight.[/p][h3]🗝 [u]New Keybindings & Controls[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]E to interact[/b]: No more reliance on the mouse alone. Keyboard play is now more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Space to advance dialogue[/b]: No need to click through every line, baby. Your thumb's all you need.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Left CTRL to skip cutscenes[/b]: Sometimes you’ve already lived a moment. Now you can glide on through![/p][/*][/list][h3]🚀 [u]Movement Enhancements[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sprint toggle[/b]: Hold Shift to move faster where it makes sense. Take it sleazy or gogogogogogo, the choice is yours![/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [u]Customization Options[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Mouse sensitivity slider[/b]: Dial in exactly how fast you turn![/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue speed slider[/b]: Adjust the text scroll rate to match your reading flow. Zippy or leisurely, both work![/p][/*][/list][h3]📑 [u]Objectives Menu[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]TAB opens a new Objectives overlay[/b]: Keep track of what you're doing! Subtle chirps notify you when new goals are added.[/p][/*][/list][h3]💾 [u]Seamless Auto-Save[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]Automatic save on scene load[/b]: No need to remember to save! Your journey is protected.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧭 [u]In-Game Controls Reference[/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]New button in the pause menu[/b]: Need a reminder? A full control cheat-sheet is right there. I promise I won't tell if you need to sneak a peek![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone playing, streaming, reviewing, and sharing [i]MORTAL ADVOCATE[/i]. These changes are based on feedback, observation, and a relentless desire to let the story breathe [b][i]without the interface getting in your way.[/i][/b][/p][p]This is [i][u]The Interface Doctrine[/u][/i] and it’s live now! Happy playing![/p][p][/p][p]Love, [/p][p]aliumfungus @ Fungal Works [/p]

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Here at FungalWorks we are terminally silly geese. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585290/c1f2c439e84c7f921acee405ecf30fbd0f5f353a.gif[/img]

We accidentally flipped a variable which zooped the player past 1.5+ hrs of content straight to the ending scene. Oopsie doopse! We are a terribly silly fungus. That should be fixed!

Also in the works is a V1.1 major update which will eliminate soft locks and such. That is a bit of work so that's not today, but it is coming!

Hopefully now you can actually enjoy the FULL GAME without being locked out of the death parlour or skipped straight to the end. 

If we look at this positively, though, it's like I'm giving a whole DLC chapter for free and as a surprise! Hooray!

As always, thanks for playing!
